mapper.select: select sri.trade_amount as tradeAmt, sri.stock_code as code, sri.stock_name as name, sri.trade_volume as tradeVol, (sri.cur_price-sri.pre_close_price)/sri.pre_close_price as increase, (sri.cur_price-sri.pre_close_price) as upDown, (sri.max_price-sri.min_price)/sri.pre_close_price as amplitude, sri.cur_price as tradePrice, sri.pre_close_price as preClosePrice, sri.cur_time as curDate from stock_rt_info as sri where cur_time = #{curDate} order by upDown desc

select sri.trade_amount as tradeAmt, sri.stock_code as code, sri.stock_name as name, sri.trade_volume as tradeVol, (sri.cur_price-sri.pre_close_price)/sri.pre_close_price as increase, (sri.cur_price-sri.pre_close_price) as upDown, (sri.max_price-sri.min_price)/sri.pre_close_price as amplitude, sri.cur_price as tradePrice, sri.pre_close_price as preClosePrice, sri.cur_time as curDate from stock_rt_info as sri where cur_time = #{curDate} order by upDown desc limit 4

SELECT date_format( cur_time, '%Y%m%d%H%i') as time, COUNT(*) AS count FROM stock_rt_info WHERE cur_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND (cur_price - pre_close_price) / pre_close_price
>=0.1
<= -0.1
GROUP BY time

select tmp2.title, count(*) as count from (select case when tmp.rate >0.07 then '>7%' when tmp.rate >0.05 and tmp.rate <=0.07 then '5%~7%' when tmp.rate >0.03 and tmp.rate <=0.05 then '3%~5%' when tmp.rate >0 and tmp.rate <=0.03 then '0~3%' when tmp.rate >-0.03 and tmp.rate <=0 then '-3%~0' when tmp.rate >-0.05 and tmp.rate <-0.03 then'-5%~-3%' when tmp.rate >-0.07 and tmp.rate <=-0.05 then '-7%~-5%' else '<7%' end 'title' from(select (sri.cur_price-pre_close_price)/pre_close_price as rate from stock_rt_info as sri where cur_time = #{curTime} )as tmp) as tmp2 group by tmp2.title;

select sri.cur_time as date, sri.trade_amount as tradeAmt, sri.stock_code as code, sri.min_price as lowPrice, sri.pre_close_price as preClosePrice, sri.stock_name as name, sri.max_price as highPrice, sri.open_price as openPrice, sri.trade_volume as tradeVol, sri.cur_price as tradePrice from stock_rt_info as sri where sri.stock_code = #{stockCode} and sri.cur_time between #{startDate} and #{endDate}

select sri2.cur_time as date, sri2.trade_amount as tradeAmt, sri2.stock_code as code, sri2.min_price as lowPrice, sri2.pre_close_price as preClosePrice, sri2.stock_name as name, sri2.max_price as highPrice, sri2.open_price as openPrice, sri2.trade_volume as tradeVol, sri2.cur_price as tradePrice from stock_rt_info as sri2 where sri2.stock_code = #{stockCode} and sri2.cur_time in ( select max(sri.cur_time) as closeDate from stock_rt_info as sri where sri.stock_code = #{stockCode} and sri.cur_time between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by date_format(sri.cur_time,'%Y%m%d') ) order by sri2.cur_time
